class.name: aubo_e5_controllers/AuboPassthroughTrajectoryController
class.description: FollowJointTrajectory action server that forwards a whole trajectory (remapped to the authoritative joint order, optionally preceded by a C1 smoothstep blend segment) point-by-point to the hardware via the trajectory_passthrough GPIO command interfaces, and reports the result only after a goal-hold position/velocity check (aubo_boot semantics).

class.name: aubo_e5_controllers/AuboIOController
class.description: Publishes board/tool IO states (aubo_msgs/IOState), robot status (aubo_msgs/RobotStatus) and RIB status (std_msgs/Int32MultiArray) from the aubo_io GPIO state interfaces, and offers a ~/set_io service (aubo_msgs/SetIO) with async-success confirmation.
